route.conditions: Current free service financed by Global Center for Evidence Synthesis; policy may change.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated in the cited policy; independent fee audit needed.

fee_evidence.note: Official policy states no submission and publication fees for the indicated route.

records.name: Population Health Management
records.scope_notes: Population health management, relevant nonclinical population-level research and reviews; disease-management relevance required.

route.conditions: Standard subscription route is free; optional open access and optional print color have charges.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated in the cited policy; independent fee audit needed.

fee_evidence.note: Official policy states no submission and publication fees for the indicated route.

notes: Bulgaria policy explicitly covers AI-generated text, data analysis, and other research components with disclosure and author accountability.

Evidence Public Health permits generated writing with disclosure, but explicit research and analysis/code permission was not found; AI auditor must assess and exclude if unclear. Its copyright statements conflict.
Sage permits disclosed research assistance, generated text and code, but prohibits AI analysis of experiences and themes; AI auditor should preserve this restriction.
Excluded Future-Journal of Public Health, Policy and Digital Medicine: mandatory conference registration https://fupress.org/journal/JPHPDM/index.php/journal.
These are discovery candidates, not verified recommendations; independent geography, fee, AI and editorial audits remain necessary.
